sloka: उद्विजन्ते यथा सर्प्पान्नरादनृतवादिन: ।धर्म: सत्यं परो लोके मूलं स्वर्गस्य चोच्यते ॥ २.१०९.१२॥
transliteration: udvijante yathā sarppānnarādanṛtavādina: ।dharma: satyaṁ paro loke mūlaṁ svargasya cocyate ॥ 2.109.12॥

translations.english: People are frightened at the sight of a man speaking untruth as though they have seen a serpent. Truth in this world is the greatest virtue and is said to be the very foundation of heaven.
